title: Spike Stones
author: Dark Sun Engine
description: A new 4th-level spell for clerics, druids and rangers of earth: Spike Stones. Obsidian shards push up through the ground for 3d4 rounds; every square walked into there cuts for 1d4, no save, and so does standing there as they rise. Flying and burrowing creatures are untouched, as with the other ground spells. It uses Magical Stone's icon, Quicksand's casting and Wall of Stone's look for the stones. Off: the game has only the original's spells.
